title: Billing controls, reports and access improvements
notes: Fix attachment policy helper permissions so authenticated safety and form uploads can pass storage checks.
Invoice and ticket dialogs gain keyboard focus handling and named controls; 15 internal screens checked at phone, tablet and desktop widths.
Multi-role capability checks now preserve combined dashboard, ticket and timesheet actions and operator fleet access.
Atomic invoice saves, payment and credit history with reversals, approval before issue, and minimum billing quantities. All four new billing migrations are required before deployment.
Reports add date/customer/unit filters, paginated data, employee hours, separate currency and credit totals, CSV and print exports.
Combined-role access, safe PWA update defaults, disabled-by-default test login, lazy routes and isolated CI verification.
